title: Big Blow To TMC Ahead Of July 21 Rally: Calcutta HC Refuses To Lift ED Freeze On Rs 440 Crore Party Accounts
description: The Calcutta High Court has refused to grant interim relief to the Trinamool Congress, allowing the Enforcement Directorate's freeze on three bank accounts holding around Rs 440 crore to continue in an alleged money laundering case linked to aircraft and helicopter purchases.
